key-refused: Jellyfin refused the API key. Create one in Jellyfin under Dashboard → API Keys and enter it here.

forbidden.server: Jellyfin accepted the key but won't show it the server's details (403 Forbidden). Use a key from Dashboard → API Keys, not a user's access token.
forbidden.library: Jellyfin accepted the key but won't let it read the library (403 Forbidden). Use a key from Dashboard → API Keys, not a user's access token.
forbidden.scan: Jellyfin accepted the key but won't let it ask the library to look at new files (403 Forbidden). Use a key from Dashboard → API Keys, not a user's access token.

not-jellyfin: The service at this address answered, but not the way Jellyfin does. Check the address.
other-product: The service at this address is {{product, vendor}}, not Jellyfin.
not-found: Jellyfin wasn't found at this address (404 Not Found for {{route}}). If Jellyfin runs under a base path, include it, for example http://192.168.1.10:8096/jellyfin.

version.not-comparable: Jellyfin reported the version “{{version, vendor}}”, which the app can't compare with {{minimum}}, the oldest version it reads libraries from.
version.too-old: This is Jellyfin {{version, vendor}}; the app reads libraries from Jellyfin {{minimum}} or later. Update Jellyfin, then test again.

parts-not-found.movie: Jellyfin no longer finds the other parts of a movie it has just listed (404 Not Found); its library is changing. Try again once Jellyfin's library scan has finished.
parts-not-found.episode: Jellyfin no longer finds the other parts of an episode it has just listed (404 Not Found); its library is changing. Try again once Jellyfin's library scan has finished.

without-id.movie: The service at this address listed a movie without an id, which Jellyfin never does. Check the address.
without-id.episode: The service at this address listed an episode without an id, which Jellyfin never does. Check the address.
without-id.series: The service at this address listed a series without an id, which Jellyfin never does. Check the address.

odd-id.movie: The service at this address listed a movie in several parts under an id Jellyfin never gives, so the app won't ask for its other parts. Check the address.
odd-id.episode: The service at this address listed an episode in several parts under an id Jellyfin never gives, so the app won't ask for its other parts. Check the address.

wrong-type.movie: Jellyfin listed an item of type “{{type, vendor}}” when asked for movies only, so the app can't rely on the list. Check the address.
wrong-type.episode: Jellyfin listed an item of type “{{type, vendor}}” when asked for episodes only, so the app can't rely on the list. Check the address.
wrong-type.series: Jellyfin listed an item of type “{{type, vendor}}” when asked for series only, so the app can't rely on the list. Check the address.

poster.not-jpeg: Jellyfin answered the poster with something that isn't a JPEG image.
poster.none: Jellyfin has no poster for this item.

identify.episode-unidentifiable: Jellyfin identifies movie and series items only, so a link on an episode stays in the app.

wrong-type.movie: Jellyfin holds an item of type “{{type, vendor}}” under this id, not a movie, so the app didn't identify it. Sync the library and link it again.
wrong-type.series: Jellyfin holds an item of type “{{type, vendor}}” under this id, not a series, so the app didn't identify it. Sync the library and link it again.

identify.no-administrator: Jellyfin has no enabled administrator account to read the item as.
identify.item-gone: Jellyfin no longer has this item; sync the library and link it again.
identify.hidden-from-administrator: Jellyfin's administrator account can't see this item (a parental limit, a blocked tag or no access to its library), so the app can't read it as that account.
identify.search-forbidden: Jellyfin refused the search for the match. Check that the API key belongs to an administrator.
identify.search-refused: Jellyfin refused the search for the match; nothing was changed.
identify.apply-forbidden: Jellyfin refused to identify the item. Check that the API key belongs to an administrator.
identify.apply-refused: Jellyfin refused the match it was sent; nothing was changed.

no-match.tmdb-film: Jellyfin found no film with TMDb id {{id}}. Check the id, and that TheMovieDb is among this library's metadata sources in Jellyfin.
no-match.tmdb-show: Jellyfin found no show with TMDb id {{id}}. Check the id, and that TheMovieDb is among this library's metadata sources in Jellyfin.
no-match.omdb: Jellyfin's Open Movie Database found no title with IMDb id {{id}}. Check that it is among this library's metadata sources in Jellyfin.
no-match.ambiguous-tmdb: Jellyfin found more than one result for TMDb id {{id}}, so the app picked none.
no-match.ambiguous-imdb: Jellyfin found more than one result for IMDb id {{id}}, so the app picked none.
no-match.no-name-tmdb: Jellyfin's result for TMDb id {{id}} has no name, so the app picked none.
no-match.no-name-imdb: Jellyfin's result for IMDb id {{id}} has no name, so the app picked none.

identify.item-locked: This item is locked in Jellyfin (the whole item, its name or its overview), so Jellyfin wouldn't take the match. Unlock it there, then retry.

conflicting-id.imdb: Jellyfin holds IMDb id {{held}} for this item, not {{wanted}}, and the app doesn't replace a library's own ids on its own. If the link is right, press Retry to identify it anyway; otherwise change the link.
conflicting-id.tmdb: Jellyfin holds TMDb id {{held}} for this item, not {{wanted}}, and the app doesn't replace a library's own ids on its own. If the link is right, press Retry to identify it anyway; otherwise change the link.
conflicting-id.imdb-uncheckable: Jellyfin holds IMDb id {{held}} for this item and TMDb gives no IMDb id for this link to compare it with, so the app doesn't replace a library's own id on its own. If the link is right, press Retry to identify it anyway; otherwise change the link.

identify.answer-lost: The match was sent to Jellyfin, but its answer never came, and the item read again doesn't show it. Jellyfin may still be working on it: Retry in a few minutes checks again before sending anything.
identify.answer-timed-out_one: The match was sent to Jellyfin, but it didn't answer within {{count, number}} minute, and the item read again doesn't show it. Jellyfin may still be working on it: Retry in a few minutes checks again before sending anything.
identify.answer-timed-out_other: The match was sent to Jellyfin, but it didn't answer within {{count, number}} minutes, and the item read again doesn't show it. Jellyfin may still be working on it: Retry in a few minutes checks again before sending anything.
identify.answer-failed: Jellyfin answered the match with {{status}}, and the item read again doesn't show it. Its own log says why; the item may have lost its images. Retry checks again before sending anything.
identify.not-confirmed: Jellyfin took the match, but the item read again doesn't show it (its name, year or id): it may be locked, or its metadata sources failed. Its own log says why; Retry checks again.
identify.read-again-failed: Jellyfin took the match, but the app couldn't read the item again to confirm it. {{error, message}}

library.writes-files: Jellyfin's library “{{library, vendor}}” saves {{saved, list:and:message}} next to the media, so identifying this item could change files in your media folders; the app left it alone. Switch that off in the library's settings in Jellyfin, then retry.
library.writes-files-unnamed: Jellyfin's library “(unnamed)” saves {{saved, list:and:message}} next to the media, so identifying this item could change files in your media folders; the app left it alone. Switch that off in the library's settings in Jellyfin, then retry.
library.unknown: The app couldn't tell what this item's Jellyfin library saves next to the media ({{why, message}}), so it left the item alone.

why.no-library-clause: none of Jellyfin's libraries holds the item's path
why.save-local-metadata-clause: its SaveLocalMetadata setting is missing or isn't a yes or a no
why.metadata-savers-clause: its MetadataSavers setting isn't a list
why.save-trickplay-clause: its SaveTrickplayWithMedia setting is missing or isn't a yes or a no
why.subtitle-languages-clause: its SubtitleDownloadLanguages setting isn't a list
